PMP 2027 continues with Polity Lecture 1 by G. Babu Sir, who has cleared UPSC CSE thrice. This session marks the beginning of Polity classes for aspirants preparing for UPSC Prelims 2027. Watch the live lecture to study an important part of the GS syllabus and strengthen your preparation with LevelUp IAS.

Enrollment Open in PMP 2027: https://shorturl.at/YvX9J

Call at 8826496658

Meet us - 📍Location: LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre; Google Map - https://maps.app.goo.gl/NvPyzytSwDQYEu8PA
Address - 2nd Floor, 45 Pusa Road, Opp. Metro Pillar 128, Karol Bagh
